Instrument (EN): Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale for Teachers — Turkish original teacher-focused instrument
Scales / measured domains (EN): 3 factors: AI Use and Learning Self-Efficacy (11); Pedagogical AI Integration Self-Efficacy (7); AI Awareness and Understanding Self-Efficacy (4).
Research provenance: Topcubaşı et al. Frontiers in Education, published 2026-10-23, DOI 10.3389/feduc.2026.1948951. Original teacher-specific instrument: independent EFA N313 and CFA N559 Türkiye educators. Initial three-factor CFA RMSEA .098/CFI .900; posthoc 12 correlated residuals gave RMSEA .067/CFI .956. Not the generic AISES 22-item instrument already in master.
DB locales: Research-only candidate; not an activated current Supabase assessment edition.

Independent EFA and CFA cohorts but acceptable CFA fit depends on 12 post-hoc residual correlations, not prespecified; broad external replication needed. Do not conflate with original generic AISES 22. No questionnaire/scoring online release.

Instrument (EN): Lung Transplant Quality of Life Survey — original English clinical instrument
Question count: 60 final items (84 field-tested; initial candidate pool 126)
Scales / measured domains (EN): 10 clinical HRQoL scales covering pulmonary and gastrointestinal symptoms, dyspnea, neuromuscular symptoms, treatment burden, cognitive limits, health distress/future-health worry, anxiety/depression, sexual problems and overall quality of life; 3 second-order composites referenced in later Polish validation.
Research provenance: Singer JP et al., Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2019 DOI 10.1164/rccm.201806-1198OC. Original N201 lung transplant recipients (43 cognitive interview respondents preceding), 60-item 10-domain retained final form; CFA CFI .990, SRMR .062; per-scale alpha .75-.95. This is ORIGINAL SOURCE family; Polish 2026 adaptation stored separately.
DB locales: Metadata-only new reference; not a published Holistic House assessment.
EN form: EN-US original developed/studied 2019; not a new translation; exact original licensed online item set must be authorized.

ES form: No independently verified Spanish clinical adaptation.

Target population: Adults post lung transplantation, US research n201; transplant-specific clinical assessment, not general psychological screening.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Need establish instrument author/publisher right to commercially reproduce exact complete questionnaire, score it online and interpret/reuse norms; freely accessible scholarly article is not an automatic SaaS instrument grant.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / CLINICIAN_ONLY. Original 2019 60 item 10 scales; requires transplant clinical context, consent/privacy, rights, validated electronic scorer; no question text or clinical threshold activated.
